responsibility: Defines the command-line options specific to the PDP-11 target and maps them onto target masks consumed by the backend. The table declares CPU model selection, assembler dialect selection, hardware versus software floating point, 16-bit versus 32-bit int, split I&D space, AC0 floating return convention, and LRA enablement, providing the option metadata that GCC uses to parse flags and set TARGET_* state before pdp11.cc and pdp11.h apply target-dependent behavior.
same_name_distinction: Is the target option-definition table, declaring PDP-11-specific command-line switches and mapping them to target masks such as DEC_ASM, FPU, INT32, SPLIT, and LRA. Unlike pdp11.h and pdp11.md, it does not define ABI or instruction patterns, and unlike pdp11.cc, it contains no backend hook implementations; it is the flag-parsing metadata that drives those other same-stem files’ behavior.
